name: Amelie Pahl
headline: CDTM Management Team | Doctoral Candidate at TUM

ca.about:
Amelie Pahl studied Management (M.A.) at the University of St Andrews in Scotland and recently completed her M.Sc. in Entrepreneurship at Trinity College Dublin in Ireland.

In between Amelie worked fulltime as a Management Consultant for PwC in Frankfurt participating in various outsourcing and process optimisation projects. Following her time at PwC Amelie pursued the opportunity of working as a Key Account Manager for a South African SME in the Tourism Industry spending a year in Cape Town working fulltime.

Amelie joined the CDTM management team in February 2021. At CDTM she is responsible for ELab, the Community Engagement Taskforce as well as abroad relations. For her PhD she joined the Chair for Digital Services and Sustainability at LMU, with Prof. Kranz, where she focusses her research on the adoption of sustainability practcies in digital entrepreneurship.

summary:
Aspiring to build and scale things that work. Passionate about driving equity for women and fostering family balance – without compromising ambition.

I’m a generalist working hands-on across operations, strategy, and partnerships. I’m most comfortable in fast-paced environments where structure is missing and things need to get done quickly.

Currently: Part of the CDTM Management Team and pursuing a PhD at TUM, focused on how VC-backed entrepreneurship can scale sustainably alongside real life.

Looking to connect with founders and operators who care about execution, equity, and building businesses that work alongside real life.

company.name: Center for Digital Technology and Management (CDTM)
company.tagline: Connect, Educate and Empower the Innovators of Tomorrow
company.description:
The Center for Digital Technology and Management (CDTM), a joint institution of the Ludwig-Maximilians-Universität München (LMU) and the Technische Universität München (TUM), offers talented students the international and interdisciplinary study program Technology Management. 

The CDTM focuses on how to manage High-Tech in close cooperation with industry, research and education, while simultaneously being committed to preparing the students for future leadership positions in their professional career.
